style: cinematic 3D cartoon, Pixar quality, slapstick comedy
motion_rule: camera locked at his eye level, jolting only on the mic at 0.0 and the drop at 9.7; he grows only by walking at the lens at 0.9 and 4.5
character: HERO: lanky stubbly shift-worker mosquito, heavy-lidded eyes, long proboscis, work shirt
cast: NEIGHBOUR: a second mosquito with an identical sack, backlit, crosses at the lens in 0.3 s at 6.1. Not copies of the HERO, none speak
props: SACK: glossy ruby-red ball-sack on straps, holds its round shape, ripples once on impact and rounds back. BEAD: same, half the size, on a thin thread. MIC: shotgun mic in grey foam on a boom. GLASS: one tall glass at the left, always in frame
prop_continuity: sack on his back 0.0-2.1; on the table and HIS BACK BARE 2.1-4.2; the bead lands on his back at 4.2 and stays; both on him 4.5-9.3
setting: blazing midday sun overhead: a wooden terrace table, boards bleached white, crisp hard-edged black shadows, bright open sunlit background, the glass throwing a sun glint

audio.language: Russian, lines verbatim; latin hints never spoken
audio.delivery: weary deadpan male chest voice near 130 Hz, even 4.3 syllables/sec
audio.pacing: one pause only, 7.3-7.9, silent; no other pause, endings voiced, nothing after 9.3
audio.lip_sync: mouth opens and closes clearly on every syllable, never a voice over

timeline.a: silent. The mic rams in point blank; he recoils whole-body, the sack swings forward and folds his hind legs
he swings round to the lens, the sack whipping full circle and slamming his back, and he keeps coming till his head fills the frame
silent. He drops the sack on the table, BAM: it ripples and rounds back, the glass jumps, he pops up. HIS BACK IS BARE
both front legs sweep one wide arc over the sack from frame edge to frame edge, dust kicking up off the boards behind the sweep. Back bare
silent. The bead comes down on its thread onto his back; he sinks flat, wings fanning out across the whole frame
one continuous move: the proboscis flings the sack off the table onto his shoulder and he keeps walking at the lens with it, hind legs buckling, till he fills the frame
same sentence, no breath. The NEIGHBOUR blasts past at the lens and shoulders him; he spins half round, finishes over his shoulder
silent, the only pause. A razor-edged black palm shadow wipes across the sunlit table and is gone; as it goes two mosquitoes scatter large in front; he ducks only after it passed
the same over-shoulder yank, but the sack is already on him: he hauls himself to it instead and swings on his wings, he and the sack rising and dropping through the whole tall frame together
silent. A razor-edged shadow darkens the whole frame without hiding it, boards, glass and mic still visible, then slides off an empty spot
one beat: sack and bead drop out of empty air, the sack ripples and rounds back, the mic sways empty, the bead still rolling as the clip ends

must_appear: the NEIGHBOUR and his sack at 6.1, two mosquitoes at 7.3, the palm shadow at 7.3 and 9.3, the bead at 3.9
negative_prompt: night, dusk, dark scene, moody lighting, low key, lamplight, blood, red liquid, the sack bursting, leaking or going flat, crushed or dead insect, a human hand or body in frame, only its shadow, a second copy of the HERO, the HERO changing shirt or shape, a third sack on him, two glasses or mics, weightless props, cuts, any frame without the HERO before 9.3, camera pan, dolly, zoom, subtitles, captions, watermark, text overlay, English speech, foreign accent, drawn-out delivery, stretched vowels, swallowed endings
